name: publishwith.ai API
description:
REST API for publishing governed AI-generated reports and dashboards.
Designed for ChatGPT Custom Actions and any HTTP client.

**Base URL:** `https://publishwith.ai`

**Auth:** Bearer token — generate a personal API key from Connect.
API keys are for ChatGPT Actions and clients that cannot complete OAuth;
Enterprise workspaces may restrict or disable key creation.
